messages:
alisa (Sales): Heads-up — AcmeCorp SIG is due next Tue. They want question-by-question evidence for ~30 controls. Can we assemble a minimal deliverable by EOD Friday?
mark (Solutions): I can take the infra/network controls list. Quick ask: do we reuse the existing control pack or generate per-question artifacts?
jordan (Security): Reuse where possible but need per-question references (policy doc + screenshot/log). I have the KMS rotation proof and access control matrix ready.
sara (SalesOps): FYI finance asked about any potential redlines for Dedicated pricing if they request on-prem later. That can be a follow-up, don't block SIG.
alisa (Sales): Good. Priority: Q12 (key rotation), Q18 (multi-tenant isolation), Q23 (incident response), Q27 (data residency). I'll route Qs across owners.
mark (Solutions): For Q18 isolation -> I'll attach our tenancy diagram and the nginx/istio config snippet they asked for. Snippet: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: DestinationRule
metadata:
  name: redwood-segmentation
```
jordan (Security): For Q12 key rotation: reference is https://redwood-internal/docs/security/kms-rotation.pdf (internal). Evidence: rotation logs + KMS policy ARN. I'll drop a sanitized export to S3.
infra-bot: upload complete: s3://redwood-sig-evidence/acme/rotation-2025-02-04.zip (checksum: a3f5c9).
mark (Solutions): I exported a screenshot of the tenant isolation dashboard and saved at: https://internal-storage/redwood/sigs/acme/isolation-screen-01.png
sara (SalesOps): Alisa — do we want to include a short cover sheet summarizing where answers are redacted/partial? Customer prefers explicit callouts.
alisa (Sales): Yes, include a cover sheet that states: "Redacted items: third-party vendor contracts; full audit logs provided under NDA." Keep tone neutral.
jordan (Security): One blocker: Q23 incident response — we need a signed incident playbook excerpt from Legal for sharing. Legal says they can produce a sanitized excerpt by Friday AM.
mark (Solutions): POC note for Sales: if Acme asks to validate throughput on Dedicated, we have a reserved slot next Wed; can offer a short demo. Keep separate from SIG but note it in the doc.
sara (SalesOps): I'll draft the cover sheet and the evidence index (question -> file mapping). Will share a PR link in this thread when done.
alisa (Sales): Timeline: everyone – please drop artifacts or links into the S3 folder by Friday 12:00 PST. Jordan, confirm Legal excerpt ETA. Mark, upload diagrams + config. Sara, draft cover + index. I'll assemble and upload the zip.
jordan (Security): Confirmed — Legal ETA Friday 09:00 PST. I'll add the KMS logs and the access matrix by 11:30.
mark (Solutions): Uploaded: https://internal-storage/redwood/sigs/acme/diagrams-v2.pdf and config bundle at s3://redwood-sig-evidence/acme/configs-v2.tar.gz
infra-bot: upload complete: s3://redwood-sig-evidence/acme/configs-v2.tar.gz (checksum: b7d9ef).
sara (SalesOps): PR for cover + index: https://git.internal/redwood/sig-deliverables/pulls/42 — comments welcome. I'll snapshot a PDF into the S3 folder after approvals.
alisa (Sales): Great progress. One more ask: Acme asked a clarifying q about our quantization/privacy stance — Jordan, can you draft a short blurb (2-3 lines) we can paste into Q29 answer about model weights and customer data separation?
jordan (Security): Draft: "We do not persist customer inputs in model weights. Models served in hosted mode do not incorporate customer data into upstream training. For private deployments, customers control model artifacts and weights." Will add to the index.
mark (Solutions): Minor note on Q18: include the tenant-level RBAC table exported from Console -> Admin -> Tenants. I exported it as tenants-rbac.csv to the S3 folder.
infra-bot: upload complete: s3://redwood-sig-evidence/acme/tenants-rbac.csv (checksum: d4c1a2).
sara (SalesOps): All right — I'm merging the PR now and will generate the final ZIP. Expect final upload Friday 16:00 PST.
alisa (Sales): Thanks team — I'll prepare the delivery email to Acme and cc Jordan for any security clarifications. If anything slips, flag here. :thumbsup:
